# GEO tank models for the tank designer, GENERATED by the GEO import (see bffu_geo_tanks.asset).
# Per researched chassis: the GEO model of that tank (weight 4), nation versions for the countries GEO
# painted it for (weight 5), generic tiers by service year (weight 3), every GEO model of a country as
# extra options (weight 1). Base-game models are removed from the other tank graphic_db files; tanks GEO
# has no model of keep theirs here.
